title: 第七章奇葩的王麻子第八章楚玉璃 大叔请帮帮我
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 这是他第一次御剑，虽然恐高，但仍旧面不改色。
自己的女人还在身边，岂能损失币格。
从高处向下看是一幅绝美的画面，周围云雾不断，重岩叠嶂，到处都是百丈的大山。
隐隐能够看到周围的妖兽，他们皆是瑟瑟发抖的躲了起来。
这些妖兽大部分修为不超过练气五层，最深处也在筑基之下，岂能不避其锋芒。
李长寿能够在此地生存，可是下了不少功夫，特地找了一个距离妖兽偏远的位置。
常年封闭洞口，只留下一个缝隙，妖兽也很难找得到。
苏千凡的表情并没有那么夸张，反而是把目光全都集中在李长寿的身上。
这也能够看出，这些场面对于曾经的她来说，不过是小场面，早已见怪不怪。
大约过了三天的时间，李长寿终于寻到了他所想的僻静之地。
黑风城，这是一座偏离落后的古城，距离最近的修仙势力都有着五百里之多。
城中的贫富差距两极分化，富有的能够请动仙人胡作非为，暗地里烧杀抢掠。
穷的则是连一顿饱饭都是奢望。
城东最为富足，有着无数商铺，到处都是衣着华丽之人。
李长寿神识微微一扫，只找到了不少练气期，还有少量筑基修士。
能够有着这等修为，背后定然牵扯着宗门或者世家。
作为一名苟修，这里显然不适合他，手中的数千灵石完全可以在这里买一套宅子，可他不愿沾染因果。
至少在自己未曾强大起来时这样。
“城南最为贫瘠，先去那里看看吧！”
一念至此，两人便来到了城南。
眼前是破败的场景，狭窄的巷道泥泞不堪，堆满了各式各样的垃圾，以及半死不活的人。
他们浑身狼狈不已，有着多数伤痕，倒像是逃难的流民。
若非李长寿有神识，根本看不出他们是死是活。
垃圾堆的上方则是有着不少草棚，成群结队的老鼠在垃圾堆中四处乱窜，到处都是冲天的恶臭，直冲天灵盖。
可以说，放一堆破砖烂瓦堆在这里，都能算是这里的富人。
“这这这...这也太难闻了，夫君，咱们快离开这吧！”
苏千凡忍不住捂住鼻子，下意识地后退了几步。
就算她被追杀也没有经历过这些，这对她来说简直就是地狱。
这些躺在地上的流民听到这软软糯糯的声音，全都爬了起来，对苏千凡露出贪婪的目光。
好在李长寿手指一抬，释放出了一道灵压，这些流民瞬间四散而逃，头也不敢回，生怕死在这里。
“地痞随处可见，连一座简单的房屋都没有，这里确实不适合。”
李长寿牵起苏千凡的手，选择离开这里。
临走之前他回头看了看，总觉得要错过什么。
看了看苏千凡仍旧在捂着口鼻，只好选择作罢。
打算先安定好，有时间再过来看看。
苏千凡也觉得自己太过招摇，只好带上了一层面纱。
尽管如此，依旧遮挡不住她身上的光芒。
看不清脸，傲人的身段倒是一览无余，难免会被人觊觎。
在一番权衡之下，李长寿最终选了城西，花了一百灵石挑选了一座上等宅子，有点类似前世的四合院，足足有着四百平。
两个人住在这里刚刚好，至于以后添丁添人再找个大点的就是。
“这位爷，这是您的地契还请拿好。”
content_en:
This was his first time wielding a sword. Although he was afraid of heights, he remained calm.
How can he lose coins when his woman is still by his side?
Looking down from a high place is a beautiful picture, with constant clouds and mists all around, heavy rocks and mountains, and mountains of hundreds of feet everywhere.
You can vaguely see the monsters around you, and they are all shivering and hiding.
Most of these monsters have cultivation levels no higher than the fifth level of Qi training, and their deepest level is under the foundation. How can they not avoid their sharp edges?
Li Changshou was able to survive here, but he put a lot of effort into finding a location far away from the monsters.
The entrance to the cave is sealed all year round, leaving only a gap, making it difficult for monsters to find it.
Su Qianfan's expression was not that exaggerated. Instead, he focused all his attention on Li Changshou.
This can also be seen that these scenes were just small scenes to her in the past, and she had long been accustomed to them.
After about three days, Li Changshou finally found the secluded place he wanted.
Black Wind City is an ancient city that deviates from backwardness. It is five hundred miles away from the nearest immortal cultivating force.
The gap between the rich and the poor in the city is polarized. The rich can invite the immortals to do whatever they want, and secretly burn, kill and loot.
For the poor, even a full meal is a luxury.
The east part of the city is the richest, with countless shops and gorgeously dressed people everywhere.
Li Changshou scanned the area with his spiritual consciousness and found only a lot of Qi training stages and a small number of foundation-building monks.
To be able to have such a level of cultivation, there must be a sect or aristocratic family behind it.
As a cultivator, this place is obviously not suitable for him. With the thousands of spirit stones in his hand, he can buy a house here, but he doesn't want to be tainted by Karma.
At least that's the case when you're not strong yet.
"The south of the city is the most barren, let's go there first and have a look!"
After thinking about this, the two came to the south of the city.
In front of him was a dilapidated scene, with narrow alleyways filled with mud, piles of all kinds of garbage, and half-dead people.
They were all in a state of utter disarray, with numerous scars, and looked more like refugees fleeing from the disaster.
If it weren't for Li Changshou's spiritual consciousness, he wouldn't be able to tell whether they were dead or alive.
There are many straw sheds above the garbage pile. Groups of rats are scurrying around in the garbage pile. There is a stench everywhere, reaching straight to the Tianling Cap.
It can be said that if you put a pile of broken bricks and rubble here, you can be considered a rich person here.
"This, this, this... this smells too bad, husband, let's get out of here quickly!"
Su Qianfan couldn't help but cover his nose and subconsciously took a few steps back.
She had never experienced this even when she was being hunted, it was hell for her.
"Huh?"
When these refugees lying on the ground heard the soft and waxy sound, they all got up and looked at Su Qianfan greedily.
Fortunately, Li Changshou raised his finger and released a burst of spiritual pressure. The refugees immediately fled in all directions, not daring to look back for fear of dying here.
"Ruffians can be found everywhere. There is not even a simple house. This place is really not suitable."
Li Changshou took Su Qianfan's hand and chose to leave here.
Before leaving, he looked back, always feeling that he was missing something.
After looking at Su Qianfan still covering his mouth and nose, he had no choice but to give up.
I plan to settle down first and come over to have a look when I have time.
Su Qianfan also felt that he was too ostentatious, so he had to put on a veil.
Despite this, it still couldn't block the light on her body.
He couldn't see his face clearly, but his proud figure was clearly visible. It was inevitable that he would be coveted by others.
...
After some weighing, Li Changshou finally chose the west of the city and spent a hundred spirit stones to choose a high-class house, which was somewhat similar to the courtyard house in his previous life, with a total area of 400 square meters.
It's just right for two people to live here. As for adding more children in the future, we just need to find a bigger one.
"Master, this is your land deed, please take it."
